title: Scenarios
description: Build the story of an exercise: ordered events (injects), who receives them, what they demand, and the failures injected.
emptyHint: Create one, or import a YAML file.
deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? This is refused if an exercise uses it.
noInjectsHint: Add the first event of the scenario.
whoReceivesHint: Information inequality is what the exercise observes: if everybody receives everything, no gap can emerge from it.
demandsHint: Actions this event requires. Those authored by you stay flagged as “scenario author” in reports.
systemOutputHint: For an AI system under test: its scripted output at this event.
